an10.39:1.1: Atha kho āyasmā Ānando yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā Ānando Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:-- 2.
an10.39:1.3: Kittāvatā nu kho bhante saṅgho bhinno hotī ti? 3.
an10.39:1.4: Idh' Ānanda bhikkhū adhammaṃ dhammo ti dīpenti, dhammaṃ adhammo ti dīpenti, avinayaṃ vinayo ti dīpenti, vinayaṃ avinayo ti dīpenti, abhāsitaṃ alapitaṃ Tathāgatena bhāsitaṃ lapitaṃ Tathāgatenā ti dīpenti, bhāsitaṃ lapitaṃ Tathāgatena abhāsitaṃ alapitaṃ Tathāgatenā ti dīpenti, anāciṇṇaṃ Tathāgatena āciṇṇaṃ Tathāgatenā ti dīpenti, āciṇṇaṃ Tathāgatena anāciṇṇaṃ Tathāgatenā ti dīpenti, appaññattaṃ Tathāgatena
an10.39:1.5: paññattaṃ Tathāgatenā ti dīpenti, paññattaṃ Tathāgatena appaññattaṃ Tathāgatenā ti dīpenti.
an10.39:1.6: Te imehi dasahi vatthūhi avakassanti, vavakassanti, āvenikammāni karonti, āvenipātimokkhaṃ uddisanti.
an10.39:1.7: Ettāvatā kho Ānanda saṅgho bhinno hotī ti. 1.
an10.39:2.1: Samaggaṃ pana bhante saṅghaṃ bhetvā kiṃ so pasavatī ti? 2.
an10.39:2.3: Kiṃ pana bhante kappaṭṭhiyaṃ kibbisan ti? 4.
